# Vendored: xterm.js + fit addon

- Libraries: xterm.js (`xterm.js`, `xterm.css`) and its fit addon
  (`addon-fit.js`), upstream https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
- License: MIT. `xterm.css` still carries its original header
  ("Copyright (c) 2014 The xterm.js authors ... Copyright (c) 2012-2013,
  Christopher Jeffrey (MIT License)"). The minified JS files ship without a
  header as distributed upstream; the MIT terms of the upstream repository
  apply to them.

Used by the terminal view in `web/app.js`. Do not modify these files.
